evidence.body: [e002:f01] “小説を音楽にするユニット”YOASOBI。 [e002:f02] 2019年11月に公開したデビュー曲「夜に駆ける」は、公開直後から瞬く間に注目を集め、国内の各種配信チャートでも1位を席巻、現在ストリーミング累計再生回数は史上初となる12億回を突破。 [e002:f03] 2023年4月リリースTVアニメ『【推しの子】』オープニング主題歌「アイドル」は、Billboard JAPAN 総合ソング・チャート“JAPAN Hot 100”で21週連続の総合首位を獲得、Billboard JAPANの歴代連続首位記録を更新、さらに、米ビルボード・グローバル・チャート“Global Excl. [e002:f04] U.S.”、Apple Music「トップ100：グローバル」、YouTube music charts TOP 100 songs Globalでも首位を獲得し、J-POP史上初となる記録を次々と打ち立て続けた。 [e002:f05] 同年10月には、約1年半の活動を記した3rd EP『THE BOOK 3』をリリース。 [e002:f06] さらに、2023年12月から2024年1月にかけて自身初のアジアツアーYOASOBI ASIA TOUR 2023-2024を敢行し、各所でチケット即完を記録。 [e002:f07] 2024年4月には世界最大級のフェスCoachella Valley Music and Arts Festivalへ出演。 [e002:f08] 加えて、ロサンゼルス、サンフランシスコにて初のアメリカ単独公演を敢行し、チケットは販売開始わずか30分で完売。 [e002:f09] 7月には、放送中のアニメ『〈物語〉シリーズ オフ&モンスターシーズン』主題歌「UNDEAD」、「NHKスポーツテーマ2024」楽曲「舞台に立って」を続けて配信リリース。 [e002:f10] 8月、アメリカ・シカゴで開催された歴史的なフェス “Lollapalooza 2024”に初出演し、ニューヨークとボストンにてワンマンライブも開催。 [e002:f11] 国内では10月に結成5周年を迎え、2024年秋に自身初のドーム公演を完走。 [e002:f12] 12月からは自身2度目となるアジアツアーを開催。 [e002:f13] 10月には、現在放送中のドラマ『もしもこの世が舞台なら、楽屋はどこにあるのだろう』の主題歌として「劇上」を配信リリースし、Ayaseが初めて歌唱参加を行うWボーカル楽曲が話題を呼んだ。 [e002:f14] 11月には、全国14箇所40公演に及ぶ自身初のホールツアー「YOASOBI HALL TOUR 2025 WANDARA」を完走。 [e002:f15] 2026年1月には、TVアニメ『花ざかりの君たちへ』のオープニングテーマ「アドレナ」およびエンディングテーマ「BABY」をリリース。 [e002:f16] 2026年6月には4作目となるEP『THE BOOK for,』をリリースし、10月からは日本人アーティスト最大規模となる国内・アジアドーム＆スタジアムツアーを開催するなど、国内外のあらゆる場面で際立った活躍を見せている。

evidence.title: ASEAN Must Improve Investment Readiness to Accelerate Energy Transition
evidence.body: [e001:f01] However, achieving renewable energy targets requires stronger project preparation capacity, improved investment readiness, and coordination among stakeholders to convert available green finance into bankable projects. by Jessica Lee October 23, 2026 in Asean , Environment Reading Time: 3 mins read A A solar rooftop BANGKOK, Thailand – Southeast Asia’s transition to renewable energy is being slowed not by a lack of capital, but by a shortage of investment-ready projects capable of attracting private financing, according to a new analysis on the region’s clean energy ambitions. [e001:f02] Key Points ASEAN’s energy transition could add $3-5.3 trillion to regional GDP by 2050 and create 49-66 million jobs, but requires channeling funds into sustainable projects through established frameworks like the ASEAN Taxonomy and Green Bond Standards. [e001:f03] The primary challenge is not financing availability but investment readiness—the capacity to prepare bankable energy projects meeting investor expectations; only 14% of energy came from renewables in 2024 versus the 30% target for 2030. [e001:f04] Solutions include strengthening project preparation through multilateral development banks, coordinating existing facilities to reduce fragmentation, implementing de-risking mechanisms, and designing business models that match project features and attract private capital. [e001:f05] However, achieving 30% renewable energy by 2030 requires addressing investment readiness gaps. [e001:f06] Strengthening project preparation capacity and coordinating existing facilities is essential for mobilizing green investments. [e001:f07] ADVERTISEMENT However, despite the development of sustainable finance frameworks and growing investor interest, many renewable energy projects across ASEAN remain unable to secure funding due to regulatory uncertainty, weak project preparation, revenue risks and financing constraints. [e001:f08] The report highlights a significant gap between the region’s renewable energy targets and current deployment levels. [e001:f09] Investors are increasingly focused on predictable revenue streams, manageable risks and well-structured project pipelines, while policymakers continue to grapple with legal, regulatory and financial barriers. [e001:f10] Countries with clearer policy frameworks and stronger project development capabilities have generally attracted greater renewable energy investment, highlighting the importance of creating a stable and transparent investment environment. [e001:f11] To bridge the gap, the report calls for stronger project preparation support, greater involvement from development finance institutions, and wider use of risk-mitigation tools such as guarantees, blended finance and public-private partnerships. [e001:f12] As Southeast Asia seeks to meet rising energy demand while advancing climate commitments, experts say the priority should shift from mobilising additional capital to developing a stronger pipeline of investable clean energy projects capable of deploying that capital effectively. [e001:f13] ASEAN’s energy transition is being held back less by a shortage of capital than by a shortage of investment-ready renewable energy projects. [e001:f14] While the region has established sustainable finance frameworks and attracted growing investor interest, many projects remain unable to secure funding due to regulatory uncertainty, weak project preparation, revenue risks, and financing challenges. [e001:f15] Related Posts ASEAN’s Digital Economy Framework Agreement (DEFA): Key Insights for Foreign Businesses Thailand Targets High-Value Travelers at ITB Asia 2026 Brunei’s Energy Windfall: An Opportunity to Strengthen Economic Resilience Why Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) matters for the ASEAN market Despite ambitious regional targets for renewable energy deployment, current progress remains insufficient. [e001:f16] The key priority is therefore to improve the bankability of projects through stronger project development capabilities, better risk mitigation mechanisms, and greater support from development finance institutions.

evidence.title: 财政部更新法规，拟限制美国投资中国等对手国家的生物技术企业
evidence.body: [e002:f01] (2024年9月21日) 评论 华盛顿 — 美国财政部星期四(10月22日)以国家安全为由，更新一项旨在限制美国高科技投资，包括超级智能(人工智能)在内，流向中国、俄罗斯、朝鲜等美国的对手国家以及其他“关注国家”的法规，新规定将生物技术纳入了监管范围。 [e002:f02] 根据财政部的声明，拟议中的新规是对财政部已有的“对外投资安全计划”(Outbound Investment Security Program，OISP)的完善。 [e002:f03] OISP由财政部根据2023年8月9日的行政令建立，其最终规则已于2025年1月2日正式生效。 [e002:f04] 该计划主要限制和监管美国企业和美国人对特定“受关注国家”，包括中国、香港、澳门、古巴、伊朗、朝鲜和俄罗斯以及委内瑞拉在以下五大核心技术领域的投资：半导体技术与微电子、超级智能(通常称人工智能)系统、(量子信息技术、 高性能计算与超级计、 高超音速系统等。 [e002:f05] 财政部长斯科特·贝森特(Scott Bessent)星期四将生物技术新纳入了监管范围。 [e002:f06] 财政部的声明还说，对OSIP进行更新是根据《2026财年国防授权法案》中的《全面对外投资安全法案》(Comprehensive Outbound Investment National Security Act ，COINS法案)的指示进行的。 [e002:f07] 该法案于2025年底作为《2026财年国防授权法案》的一部分正式签署生效。 [e002:f08] COINS法案显著扩大了美国对外投资管制范围，要求美国公司和个人就某些投资计划向财政部申报，并在其他情况下直接禁止投资，以防止损害美国国家安全。 [e002:f09] 财政部将于12月7日前接受公众对拟议规则的意见。 [e002:f10] 贝森特在一份声明中表示：“拟议的法规将加强现有的对外投资安全计划，以防止我们的对手利用美国投资开发威胁美国国家安全的关键技术。 [e002:f11] 这些规则允许一些例外情况，包括对上市公司的投资以及价值低于5万美元的交易。 [e002:f12] 财政部表示，该提案还将允许投资者就被认为符合美国国家利益的交易申请豁免。 [e002:f13] 中国外交部发言人毛宁星期五(10月23日)在被问到美国财政部的相关规定时表示，北京“一贯反对过度解读国家安全概念，反对将科技和贸易问题政治化”。 [e002:f14] 中国商务部10月16日发表公告称，就修订《中国禁止出口限制出口技术目录》公开征求意见，并对相关技术实施出口前登记的临时管理措施。 [e002:f15] 公开征求意见涉及拟增列的人工智能、生物医药、光伏三个领域40项关键技术。 [e002:f16] 在生物制药方面，公告称除了现行目录中已有部分生物医药技术，此次拟增列病原微生物、细胞和基因治疗、小核酸药相关5项技术。

evidence.title: Trump administration cancels some Canada tariffs amid close midterm races
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Susan Collins, who’s in a tough re-election fight, said she secured from the Trump administration tariff exemptions on some agricultural and forestry items. [e005:f02] The Trump administration on Friday said it had granted tariff exemptions on some Canadian imports, an implicit acknowledgement that President Donald Trump’s signature trade policy could be hurting Republican candidates running in the Nov. [e005:f03] 3 midterm election. [e005:f04] The canceled tariffs include 50% duties on some agricultural items. [e005:f05] These duties were applied to Canadian products after the country withdrew from trade negotiations with the Trump administration in late August. [e005:f06] Susan Collins, who’s facing a tough re-election battle in Maine, first announced the news on social media: “I am pleased to have secured additional tariff exemptions products crucial to Maine’s agricultural industries, including blueberry, potato, apple, and seaweed producers.” She said that plastic boxes, crates, packing materials, refrigeration equipment, sealing and labeling machinery, packing equipment, film, foil and seaweed products were some of the other products getting exemptions. [e005:f07] A document posted to the White House website confirmed the action, but it said that the administration was also adding tariffs to “certain valves, carpets, waste products” and other items to make up for the duties it was removing. [e005:f08] Collins, in her announcement, said that many “farmers and growers rely on specialized equipment, packaging materials, and other products from Canada that are either unavailable from American suppliers or cannot be replaced without incurring significant expense.” Democrat Troy Jackson, who is challenging Collins for her Senate seat, responded by saying: “Trump’s trade wars have made life harder and more expensive for Mainers. [e005:f09] Susan Collins enabled this chaos, voted to confirm the people behind it, and now wants credit for bringing a cup of water to put out the fire.” He added on X: “Mainers needed help long before Susan Collins needed saving.” Collins’ announcement did not mention Trump, only top administration officials such as U.S. [e005:f10] The White House announcement made no mention of Collins, who has occasionally sparred with Trump. [e005:f11] “I will continue working directly with Administration officials to seek additional relief and encourage a broader trade agreement with Canada, our neighbor, ally, and largest trading partner,” Collins said. [e005:f12] Other Republicans have broken with Trump’s most well-known economic policy, too. [e005:f13] Mike Rogers, who’s in a tight race for a Senate seat in Michigan, told NBC News last week that he would like to see the trade war with Canada “wrapped up.” After U.S. officials made what Prime Minister Mark Carney called “unfair” and “uneconomic” demands, the U.S. hit Canada with two waves of tariffs, the second of which included the 50% duties. [e005:f14] “I think what’s going to happen is over the next three or four weeks, they’re going to come to us, and they’re going to say, ‘we’re going to get rid of all the tariffs,’” the president said. [e005:f15] As Trump has ramped up social media attacks, Carney has turned to the rest of the world, opening up Canada’s economy to China, India, and the United Kingdom. [e005:f16] Next week, Carney is set to reach a historic agreement with the European Union over the terms of becoming the bloc’s first-ever “associate member” during an E.U.-Canada summit in Montreal.

evidence.title: 9月CPIは3.7%、トランプ大統領のイラン行動でエネルギーコスト上昇、FRB利上げ再び視野に
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 9月の米消費者物価指数（CPI）は前年同月比3.7%上昇し、市場予想の3.6%を上回った。 [e006:f02] コアインフレ率は2.6%に加速し、6月以来の高水準となった。 [e006:f03] CMEグループのFedWatchツールでは、12月と3月にそれぞれ0.25ポイントの利上げが実施され、フェデラルファンド（FF）金利の誘導目標レンジが4.25%～4.5%に引き上げられる可能性が最も高いと示されている。 [e006:f04] S&P 500とナスダックは2026年に約12%上昇しているが、過去の歴史では、利上げサイクル開始から3カ月以内に株価が調整局面入りすることが多い。 [e006:f05] モルガン・スタンレー・ウェルス・マネジメントのリサ・シャレット氏は、企業業績とAI投資を背景に強気相場は維持されるとの見方を示す一方、債券利回りの上昇や原油価格、政策の不確実性に警鐘を鳴らしている。 [e006:f06] 米労働統計局によると、消費者物価指数（CPI）は前年同月比3.7%上昇と、5月以来の高い伸びとなり、市場予想の3.6%をわずかに上回った。 [e006:f07] 食品とエネルギーを除くコア指数は2.6%上昇し、6月以来の速いペースとなった。 [e006:f08] この報告は、インフレを2%目標に戻すFRBの取り組みがより積極的な段階に入る中で発表された。 [e006:f09] 指標 9月の数値 過去の参照値 総合CPI（前年同月比） 3.7% 5月以来の高水準、市場予想は3.6% コアCPI（前年同月比） 2.6% 6月以来の高水準 FF金利誘導目標レンジ（利上げ見込み後） 4.25%～4.5% 2025年8月以来 S&P 500 / ナスダックの2026年上昇率 約12% 4年連続の2桁上昇が視野に 注：CPIは米労働統計局、金利経路はCMEグループのFedWatchの価格に基づく。 [e006:f10] なぜ金利が株価にこれほど重要なのか 借入コストの上昇は2つの経路で株式に打撃を与える。 [e006:f11] S&P 500種株価指数（^GSPC）とナスダック総合指数（^IXIC）は今年それぞれ約12%上昇しており、両指数とも4年連続の2桁上昇に向かっている。 [e006:f12] FRBは過去四半世紀に3回の引き締めサイクルを開始しており、株式はその後にしばしば苦戦してきた。 [e006:f13] 各サイクルの最初の利上げ後の3カ月間に、S&P 500は平均10%、ナスダックは平均12%の下落を一時的に記録したとの分析がある。 [e006:f14] FRB議長のケビン・ウォーシュ氏は物価安定の回復を繰り返し誓っており、9月のデータは同氏がその姿勢を緩める余地をほとんど与えていない。 [e006:f15] 2%目標は5年以上達成されていない。 [e006:f16] しかし同氏は、相場を終わらせ得るリスクにも言及し、「債券利回りの上昇、原油価格の高止まり、政策の不確実性、低所得層の消費者における疲弊」が「2027年に向かう中で相場を試す可能性がある」と指摘した。

previous_updates.title: Nasdaq、4～6月期純収益15％増の15億ドル
previous_updates.summary: NasdaqのAdena Friedman最高経営責任者とSarah Youngwood最高財務責任者らは7月23日の決算説明会で、2026年4～6月期純収益が15億ドルと前年同期比15％増え、主要3部門がそろって2桁成長したと説明した。 ソリューション収益は17％増の12億ドル、年間経常収益は12％増の33億ドル、資本アクセス部門は調整後18％増の6億2100万ドルだった。 営業利益率は前年同期比2ポイント上昇の57％となった一方、業績連動報酬とマーケティング費用を理由に通期の非GAAP営業費用見通しを25億3000万～25億7000万ドルへ引き上げた。

Nasdaq Revenue Rises 14% as Financial Technology Business Expands
evidence.body: [e001:f01] 22), supported by growth in its financial technology and capital markets businesses as the exchange operator continues investing in technology and market infrastructure. [e001:f02] Net revenue rose 14% on an organic basis to $1.5 billion in the quarter ended Sept. [e001:f03] 30, Nasdaq said in a press release . [e001:f04] Solutions revenue, which includes its Capital Access Platforms and Financial Technology businesses, increased 18% organically to $1.2 billion. [e001:f05] The company’s reported revenue growth was 13%, reflecting the impact of portfolio changes. [e001:f06] Annualized recurring revenue, a measure of contracted revenue expected to recur over a 12-month period, reached a record $3.4 billion, up 14% organically from a year earlier. [e001:f07] Financial Technology revenue increased 16% year over year, while revenue from Capital Access Platforms, which provides services to companies and investors, grew 20%. [e001:f08] Market Services, which includes Nasdaq’s trading operations, generated $309 million in net revenue, up 2% from the prior-year quarter. [e001:f09] Add as Preferred Source Nasdaq Chair and Chief Executive Adena Friedman said the results reflected progress across the company’s businesses, including record growth in financial technology recurring revenue and the establishment of Nasdaq Digital Liquidity Networks within Market Services. [e001:f10] Non-GAAP operating expenses increased 12% on an organic basis to $638 million, driven primarily by higher compensation costs and technology investments, Nasdaq said. [e001:f11] Nasdaq also updated its 2026 guidance for non-GAAP operating expenses to a range of $2.55 billion to $2.58 billion. [e001:f12] It maintained its full-year non-GAAP tax-rate outlook of 22.5% to 24.5%. [e001:f13] The company announced in September that Nasdaq Verafin and Stablecore had partnered to help financial institutions detect financial crimes across fiat and digital asset activity. [e001:f14] The partnership is designed to unify digital asset and traditional banking data to help FIs spot financial crime. [e001:f15] Nasdaq Verafin and Stablecore have the integration in beta with select customers, per that announcement, and plan roll it out to their mutual customers in the fourth quarter of 2026 and the first quarter of 2027.
